title: RBI's Rs 50,000 crore VRRR faces muted response from market
summary: The Reserve Bank of India announced a variable rate reverse repo operation of ₹50,000 crore. This decision came after the banking system liquidity reached nearly ₹2 lakh crore on Monday. Banks opted to bid ₹23,905 crore, reflecting an asymmetry in the banking system's surplus. The weighted average call rate decreased to 5.45% from 5.50% on Monday. Another VRRR operation of ₹50,000 crore is scheduled for Wednesday.

title: Sensex, Nifty soar to a two-month high as FPIs ramp up buying activity
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty closed at their highest levels in nearly two months. Foreign investors have been net buying Indian equities, contributing to market gains over the past sessions. HDFC Bank was a significant contributor to the Nifty's gains, along with other major stocks like ICICI Bank. Decreasing crude oil prices have improved market sentiment among investors recently.

title: Sebi imposes Rs 40 lakh penalty on two brokers in Axis Mutual Fund front-running case
summary: Securities and Exchange Board of India has imposed penalties on two stockbroking firms over regulatory violations. Woodstock Broking and Marfatia Stock Broking allowed unauthorized access to their trading terminals. This access facilitated front-running trades by Prijesh Kurani, who operated from Dubai. The investigation revealed insider information was shared regarding Axis Mutual Fund's trades. The regulatory body emphasized the importance of stringent controls over terminal access and trading infrastructure.

title: D-Street braces for weak opening on negative GIFT Nifty cues

title: US mid-terms may help D-Street break free from geopolitical overhang
summary: The upcoming US mid-term elections will potentially influence global markets and trade policies. Investors are closely watching whether the outcomes will ease uncertainties regarding tariffs and immigration. The results could shape the policy direction and affect the sentiment of global investors. Analysts suggest that the focus should remain on domestic earnings growth and financial flows.

title: Irdai mandates four-tier structure for motor insurance from Dec 15
summary: Irdai will implement a four-tier structure for motor insurance covering private cars and two-wheelers. Customers will have the option to select separate covers, including mandatory third-party liability and optional personal accident cover. Existing policyholders can add occupant liability coverage without canceling their current policies.

title: Lenders accept Supreme Housing's Rs 522-crore settlement offer
summary: Canara Bank along with other lenders accepted a ₹522-crore one time settlement offer from Supreme Housing and Hospitality. This settlement will help the company resolve debts close to ₹700 crore, representing a 75% recovery for involved banks. The one-time settlement includes both fund and non-fund exposure from corporate guarantees given to subsidiary entities.

title: NBFCs redesign lending models ahead of revolving credit curbs
summary: Non-banking financial companies are innovating loan products to align with upcoming Reserve Bank of India guidelines. These guidelines aim to limit revolving credit facilities, prompting firms to develop term loans. Bajaj Finance has already begun launching new term loan variants, while Tata Capital is testing modified flexi-loan products. Other NBFCs are reviewing their positions on revolving credit exposure ahead of the final regulations.
